summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD report on monthly new residential construction for August 2022 (CB22-156). Relevant to the task: Table 5b provides Not Seasonally Adjusted (NSA) data for New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed, specifically the "1 unit" (single-family) column. The report supplies NSA single-family completion figures for August 2022 (88.9 thousand units) and preceding months (e.g., July 2022 at 83.6 thousand), covering the start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. However, it lacks data for September 2022 through May 2025, preventing verification of the peak condition for August 2022 (requires succeeding month) and all subsequent months. The August 2022 figure is preliminary ("p") and subject to revision in later reports per the task's precedence rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release for September 2022 new residential construction. Relevant to the task: Table 5b provides Not Seasonally Adjusted (NSA) monthly housing completions for single-family ("1 unit") units. The figures are marked as revised or preliminary, subject to potential revision by more recent reports in the collection.
